guitar.modelsText: Fender Jazzmaster / Gibson Les Paul / Gretsch
guitar.notes: Turner has used Jazzmasters, Gibson ES-335/Les Pauls, and various others over the band's career; no single iconic instrument, so medium confidence is appropriate.

tone.target: dark fuzzy baritone-like riff with octavey grit and roomy mono thump
tone.profile: dark fuzzy baritone-like riff with octavey grit and roomy mono thump
tone.summary: A heavy, fuzzy signal chain utilizing an OD boost for grit, followed by Distortion for thickness, feeding into the UK 45 amp with a vintage cabinet and subtle room reverb to achieve a dark, baritone thump.
corrections: Keep it dry and heavy, not airy
Favor thick riff texture over generic crunch

rig.name: Arctic Monkeys - Do I Wanna Know_ - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and unwanted noise from low-tuned/fuzzy signal.
Provide initial grit and saturation for the baritone attack.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used to simulate a dirty, low-gain boost rather than pure clean tone.

blocks.purpose: Generate the core fuzzy low-end saturation and grit.
Add thickness and sustain to the fuzzy riff texture.
Provide a punchy, British-style low-mid focused tone suitable for heavy riffs.
Ground the sound with a classic British cabinet tone.
Scoop the high end and boost low-mids to enhance the baritone thump.
Add subtle, non-airy room ambience as requested.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism to ground the dark, fuzzy low-end tone.

proposals.recommendedAsset: dark/thick 4x12 IR (e.g., Ampeg or Celestion Vintage)
proposals.reason: Enhance the dark, thick low-end thump and ground the fuzzy tone.
